function: Joint design of partially-connected hybrid beamforming and RIS phase shifts to maximize spectral efficiency, via deep-unfolded WMMSE-MO with learned step sizes (p. 1, p. 3).
system: RIS-assisted single-user downlink mmWave MIMO-OFDM; reflecting RIS, M=64 (UPA); Nt=Nr=32, 4 RF chains each, K=16 subcarriers, direct path blocked; carrier frequency not given (p. 2, 4).
method: Deep-unfolded WMMSE-MO: per-iteration small neural network (linear layer + LeakyReLU + normalization) sets the manifold-optimization step sizes; unsupervised training with negative-SE loss, Adam, batch 32 (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Custom geometric mmWave channel, L=51 paths, Rician factor 10, ULA at BS and UE, UPA at RIS; 9000 training, 1000 validation, 1000 test samples (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Training and testing on the same simulated channel setting with held-out test samples; SNR -10 to 20 dB and iteration counts varied; training SNR not stated (p. 4-5).
baselines: Non-learned: WMMSE-MO without unfolding, T-SVD (FC and PC) [14], T-WMMSE-MO, GMD-PCA [5]; learned: none other than the proposed variants (p. 4).
metrics: Average spectral efficiency (bps/Hz) versus SNR and versus inner iterations; average runtime in seconds; runtime reduction in percent (p. 4-5).
complexity: Measured average runtime in seconds per scheme (Table I): DU-WMMSE-MO(2,4) 0.0339 s versus WMMSE-MO 0.0521 s, 34.93% less; (6,4) 62.53% less (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 4: "The channel settings include a total of L = 51 paths, with a Rician factor"; Eqs. (2)-(6) on p. 2 define a custom geometric LoS plus NLoS channel with ULA and UPA steering vectors, and no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO, or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 4: "the dataset consists of 9000 training samples, 1000 validation samples, and 1000 testing samples" is a held-out split of one simulated setting; "we compare the performance of all schemes across various signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) values" is an SNR sweep only; missing: another array size, RIS size, or channel setting at test time.
q3_support: p. 4: "the original WMMSE-MO algorithm [13] adapted for the RIS scenario, following the nested iterations framework in Fig. 1 but without deep unfolding" is an ablation, and T-SVD, T-WMMSE-MO, and GMD-PCA are non-learned; missing: any earlier learned method (the learned works [7]-[9] of p. 1 are not compared).
q4_support: p. 5: "we compare the average runtime for all schemes in Table I"; the measured runtimes are in Table I, with "a substantial runtime reduction of 34.93% compared to the WMMSE-MO counterpart" for DU-WMMSE-MO(2,4).
q5_support: p. 4: "the dataset consists of 9000 training samples, 1000 validation samples, and 1000 testing samples" is self-generated simulated data; no link or DOI for code or data appears in the letter, and the CC BY license on p. 1 covers the article only.
notes: Included as area 3 (hybrid beamforming and RIS phase shifts). The learned part is small: one linear layer with LeakyReLU per MO iteration gives the step size (p. 3), counted as learned because deep unfolding with trained parameters is learned. q1 is 0: custom geometric channel following [5], no standard model. q3 is 0: every baseline is non-learned, and WMMSE-MO without unfolding is an ablation of the proposed method. q4 rests on the measured runtimes of Table I. Table I values and the legends of Fig. 2 and Fig. 3 read from the image of p. 4-5. Title and DOI on p. 1 match the work.
